dedupe_keys.name: s1 aad brazilian amazon airstrip sentinel 1 imagery and labels

description: S1-AAD provides Sentinel-1 synthetic-aperture-radar imagery and labels for 1,040 known airstrip locations in the Brazilian Amazon. The research team used MapBiomas airstrip locations and satellite scenes acquired mainly in 2021–2024. The Data in Brief article describes paired 200-by-200-pixel GeoTIFF backscatter images, PNG views, binary segmentation masks and YOLO bounding-box labels. A subset of 113 locations also has a pre-construction image selected from 2014–2021 for change-detection experiments. Mendeley version 1 publicly lists 4,509 individual imagery, annotation and geospatial files under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a selected set of known strips and available scenes, not a complete or current airport register or evidence that every strip is authorised or active. Radar interpretation, reference labels, image cropping and the smaller change-detection subset are known limitations. A reviewer-assessed use is testing airstrip detection before updating transport-access or remote-service scenarios. data-ourairports is a related airport inventory, but no common identifier or coverage comparison was checked. No image, mask or spatial file was downloaded, and model accuracy was not reproduced.
